description: Golden Dataset — DNA scenario roster (Sprint AI-R2.5, Part 6). Minimal set per brief: Saudi Modern Slim, Saudi Modern Regular, Saudi Modern Black, Saudi Modern Maroon, Saudi Modern White.

schema.id: stable slug, used in result/report filenames
schema.label: human-readable name
schema.componentSelections: array of { componentType, componentId } — componentId MUST be a real design_master_options.id (see render-testing/README.md for how to look one up); componentType is a free label only used for report readability, the DB row's own category is what the pipeline actually trusts
schema.note: free text — leave BELUM DIISI markers until every componentId is filled in
